contract.prepareOutfit: Stages equipment visibility, body geometry masks, native texture coverage and garment coverage without changing the committed outfit.
contract.commit: Commits domains in order and records each successful domain.
contract.rollback: Restores committed domains in reverse order and restores outfit/debug state.
contract.dispose: Releases superseded staged geometry after commit or candidate geometry after rollback.

test.case: body coverage remains reversible after injected later-domain failure

runtime_limit: The focused test exercises the shared body-mask rollback owner. Browser/game integration and full multi-domain outfit smoke remain with the fixed candidate owner.
